item.chainoffun.chain_of_fun.desc1: Right-click a friend to chain yourselves together.
item.chainoffun.chain_of_fun.desc2: To break free, both sneak + right-click each other.
msg.chainoffun.linked: You are now chained to %s. Have fun!
msg.chainoffun.already_linked_target: %s is already chained to someone else.
msg.chainoffun.already_linked_pair: You're already chained to %s. Sneak + right-click each other to unchain.
msg.chainoffun.unlink_request: %s wants to unchain. Sneak + right-click them within %s seconds to agree.
msg.chainoffun.unlinked: You and %s are no longer chained.
msg.chainoffun.reel_denied: Only a sneaking player on solid ground can reel the rope.
msg.chainoffun.portal_blocked: Portals only work together. Get %s into the portal with you.
msg.chainoffun.portal_blocked_offline: Your partner is offline. You can't use portals alone.
